node.statement: In the context and notation of node 1.4, set e=epsilon_r, u=u_delta(X), h=h_delta(X), and a=h-J. Since X is one of the two inputs covered by node 1.3, that node gives ||X^dagger bold-dot X-J||<=40*e; node 1.4.1 independently gives ||X^dagger bold-dot X-h bold-dot h||<40*e. The triangle inequality therefore gives ||h bold-dot h-J||<80*e, and in particular ||h bold-dot h-J||<=80*e.
